subject: Money
title: Moral Hazard of Bailouts
description: A 60-second lesson on Moral Hazard of Bailouts.

hook.text: In 2008, banks gambled, lost, and got bailed out. In 2023, Silicon Valley Bank collapsed and was rescued too.

buildup.text: Moral hazard: if you know you'll be rescued, you take bigger risks. Bailouts create incentive to misbehave.

discovery.text: Too-big-to-fail means the biggest banks can gamble freely. Losses are socialized while profits stay private.

twist.text: Not bailing out Lehman caused a global crisis. So politicians learned: always bail out. Which is also a problem.

climax.text: The system rewards risky behavior and punishes caution. The careful bank earns less than the reckless one.

punchline.text: Heads I win. Tails you bail me out.

quiz.question: What is moral hazard in banking?
options: Taking bigger risks because you expect to be bailed out
